entities.name: Wang Zhen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Wang Zhen, commonly known by his courtesy name Wang Yiting, was a prominent businessman and celebrated modern Chinese artist of the Shanghai School. He also used the art name Bailong shanren and as a devote Buddhist under other names. He was originally from Wuxing in Zhejiang Province, although spent most of his life in the city of Shanghai where he was a successful businessman-banker.

Wang Zhen was a master calligrapher as well as a painter of flowers, birds, personages and Buddhist subjects. He was closely associated with and considered the disciple of the painter Wu Changshuo. Wang Zhen was a performers & entertainers from Qingpu (1867-12-04, Qingpu–1938-11-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Wang Zhen's artistic contributions to the Shanghai School and his association with Wu Changshuo had a notable impact on modern Chinese art. His work as a businessman-banker also reflects the economic and cultural exchange between China and the global community during the early 20th century.
